headline: Ortiz vs Paulie
caption:
Former WBC champ Victor Ortiz and Paulie Malignaggi are taking off the gloves.
Ortiz or Paulie? 👇

The two boxing veterans headline BKB 62 on Dec. 5 at the Orpheum Theatre in Los Angeles, a five-round super welterweight bare knuckle fight. Ortiz won his BKB debut in July. Bare knuckle news.

Who takes it?
question: Ortiz or Paulie?
